Subject: Re: DPA & GDPR clause alignment for HelioHealth MSA/Order Form

Priyom / Elena,

Thanks — quick read of Helio_DPA_redline_v1: high-level notes below. Inline comments in attached Redwood_DPA_template_v2.docx.

1) Roles: Helio has proposed a mutual controller carveout in Section 1.1; we need clear examples (PI types, endpoints). If they insist on mutual controller language, ops will need a dataflow annex and SLA on data deletion.

2) SCCs: they referenced the 2021 modules but redlined to an older sentence structure. Confirm which SCC set they want adopted. If they want the 2010 legacy flow we need exec sign-off.

3) Subprocessors: Helio's list is incomplete — ask for the full subprocessor inventory and whether any subproc have access to raw logs.

4) KMS/HSM: they asked if we support customer-managed keys — we do but need to confirm Proc & Tech scope for the order form.

I've attached the Redwood template with tracked edits. If any of these are unacceptable to Helio, flag and we'll escalate.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_template_v2.docx (docx)

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Contracts, Redwood Inference

- Evidence: can Redwood provide a short package for: SOC2 scope, encryption at rest (KMS/HSM architecture diagram), data deletion processes, and subprocessor attestations? Ideally a one-pager per item.
- Customer-managed keys: Helio requires KMS options documented in the order form (cost/lead time).

We can do an evidence sprint next Tuesday morning PT. I'll send a calendar invite after we confirm the scope.
